import os,re
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()

import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()

def show(g,k):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    sr=[r for r in range(H) if len(set(g[r]))==1 and g[r][0]!=0]
    sc=[c for c in range(W) if len({g[a][c] for a in range(H)})==1 and g[0][c]!=0]
    print(f'--- {k}, sepR={sr}, sepC={sc}')
    # tiles
    rs=[];s=0
    for x in sr: rs.append((s,x-1)); s=x+1
    rs.append((s,H-1))
    cs=[];s=0
    for x in sc: cs.append((s,x-1)); s=x+1
    cs.append((s,W-1))
    for i,(r0,r1) in enumerate(rs):
        print('rowband',i,(r0,r1))
        for j,(c0,c1) in enumerate(cs):
            print('  tile(',i,j,'):',sorted((a-r0,b-c0,g[a][b]) for a in range(r0,r1+1) for b in range(c0,c1+1) if g[a][b]!=0))

print()

import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()

    rs=[];s=0
    for x in sepR: rs.append((s,x-1)); s=x+1
    rs.append((s,H-1))
    cs=[];s=0

            res[(i,j)]=pts
    return res
